mapper.sql: select f.framework_id, f.group_id, f.framework_name, f.year, f.lead_dept_id, f.overall_goal, f.status, f.sort, f.create_by, f.create_time, f.update_by, f.update_time, f.remark, g.group_name from task_framework f inner join biz_research_group g on g.group_id = f.group_id and g.del_flag = '0' where f.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into task_framework (group_id, framework_name, year, lead_dept_id, overall_goal, status, sort, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag) values (#{groupId}, #{frameworkName}, #{year}, #{leadDeptId}, #{overallGoal}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark}, '0')
mapper.update: update task_framework set framework_name = #{frameworkName}, year = #{year}, lead_dept_id = #{leadDeptId}, overall_goal = #{overallGoal}, status = #{status}, sort = #{sort}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate(), remark = #{remark} where framework_id = #{frameworkId} and group_id = #{groupId} and del_flag = '0'
